io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.utils.compatibility

Class BlockDataCompat

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.utils.compatibility.BlockDataCompat

  • public final class BlockDataCompat
extends java.lang.Object
    Compatibility helpers for the org.bukkit.block.data.BlockData API, which only exists from Minecraft 1.13 onwards.

    Universal-jar contract: none of these methods reference any block.data.* type in their signatures - block data is passed around as Object. This is essential: the block.data.* interfaces are compileOnly stubs that are NOT shaded into the jar (org.bukkit classes cannot be loaded from a plugin jar), so a consumer that named e.g. Orientable in its bytecode would fail class verification with NoClassDefFoundError on a legacy server. Consumers therefore hold block data as Object and read/write its properties through the reflective get(Object, String) / set(Object, String, Object) helpers, never casting to a block.data.* type.

    On legacy servers every lookup fails gracefully (returns null / no-op); on modern servers the real BlockData methods are used.

      • createBlockData

        @Nullable
public static java.lang.Object createBlockData(org.bukkit.Material material,
                                                         java.util.function.Consumer<java.lang.Object> consumer)
        Reflective equivalent of material.createBlockData(consumer) (the consumer-configured overload). The consumer receives the block data as an opaque Object (use set(Object, String, Object) to configure it). Returns null on legacy versions (the consumer is then never invoked).
        Parameters:
        material - The Material
        consumer - A consumer that configures the created block data
        Returns:
        The created block data as an opaque Object, or null on legacy versions

      • get

        @Nullable
public static java.lang.Object get(@Nullable
                                             java.lang.Object data,
                                             java.lang.String getter)
        Reflectively reads a property of a block data object, e.g. get(data, "getAxis") or get(data, "getFacing"). The result is returned as an Object (which the caller may cast to a version-safe type such as BlockFace, but never to a block.data.* type).
        Parameters:
        data - The block data Object (may be null)
        getter - The no-arg getter name
        Returns:
        The property value, or null if unavailable

      • spawnFallingBlock

        @Nullable
public static org.bukkit.entity.FallingBlock spawnFallingBlock(org.bukkit.World world,
                                                                         org.bukkit.Location location,
                                                                         org.bukkit.block.Block source)
        Spawns a FallingBlock matching the given source Block. On 1.13+ it uses the block's BlockData; on 1.8-1.12 it spawns from the block's real Material and legacy data byte (so the falling block is the actual block, not a STONE placeholder).
        Parameters:
        world - The World
        location - The spawn Location
        source - The Block to copy
        Returns:
        The spawned FallingBlock, or null if unsupported
